memo:
Summary
Sleep Number fails two covenants at the Apr 4, 2026 test, with net leverage at 6.58x against a 4.75x maximum and interest coverage at 0.84x against a 2.10x minimum. The company did not disclose a leverage table this quarter, so no reconciliation is available and pro forma savings remain subject to administrative agent approval.

Covenant tests
| Covenant | Result | Limit | Headroom |
| Net Leverage Ratio | 6.58x | 4.75x | -1.83x |
| Interest Coverage Ratio | 0.84x | 2.10x | -1.26x |

What drove it
Net leverage reflects total debt including operating leases of $962,096,000 over Consolidated EBITDAR of $146,296,000. Interest coverage reflects Consolidated EBITDA of $43,230,000 over Consolidated Interest Expense of $51,404,000. Net leverage is 5.06x even with the maximum $44M of projected savings, and 6.58x without. Interest coverage is 1.70x even with the maximum $44M of projected savings, and 0.84x without.

Cure
To pass net leverage at 4.75x, debt must fall by $267.2 million or EBITDA must rise by $56.3 million. To pass interest coverage at 2.10x, EBITDA must rise by $64.7 million or interest must fall by $30.8 million. With the maximum $44M of projected savings, net leverage still needs debt down $58.2 million or EBITDA up $12.3 million and interest coverage still needs EBITDA up $20.7 million or interest down $9.9 million. No equity cure provision was found in the reviewed agreement.

Outlook
Baseline projection holds net leverage at 6.58x into the Jul 4, 2026 test against a 4.80x maximum, which is high risk. EBITDAR would need to rise by $54.1 million to pass the Jul 4, 2026 test at the baseline projection. Company reported Adjusted EBITDA fell on average by $12.5 million per quarter endpoint to endpoint from Jun 28, 2025 to Apr 4, 2026.

Recommended actions
- Reserve rights under the agreement for the Apr 4, 2026 failures
- Review the forbearance terms, termination events and check the forbearance expiry date against the Jul 4, 2026 test
- Request the compliance certificate and support for each add-back including projected savings
- Tighten reporting to weekly liquidity and covenant forecasts through the next test
